title: Night Dead Mod
description: The night is what consumes everything
body:
**This is my first mod, don't swear too much!**

What does this mod do? Its essence is quite simple, and it is clear from the name.
• Night Dead Mod - now at night, you will receive instant damage, from which you will instantly die after 3 seconds. 
• When you are outdoors, you have 3 seconds to hide. The effect of "Darkness" is also applied to you, which foreshadows that you are in danger and are not in hiding.

**What is this mod for?**

I wrote it for my friends, in particular for my small server, it is necessary for a unique gameplay. But I decided to release it to the public, you never know who would want to play with it.

P.S. - If you are standing under a block of glass, then it will not be considered as a shelter. There will be updates in the future. You can follow them in my discord channel. See below
